newsitem.title: UK: Acco to buy UK's Nobo for 140p/shr cash.
newsitem.headline: Acco to buy UK's Nobo for 140p/shr cash.

text.p: Acco UK Ltd said on Thursday it agreed to buy British office products company Nobo Group Plc in a recommended cash offer that valued the company at about 25.6 million stg.
Acco said the bid valued each Nobo share at 140p.
Acco, a unit of Fortune Brands Inc's Acco World Corporation, said it already had acquired 17.9 percent of Nobo's capital at the offer price from Nobo's two founder non-executive directors.
Acco said it had undertakings from other parties. Combined with its existing stake, Acco said it had commitments for more than 53.3 percent of Nobo's issued share capital.
Acco said the acquisition would enable it to expand its pan-European operations.
